title: citrus × aurantium var. lima
intro: Citrus × aurantium var. lima, commonly known as Sour Orange or Seville Orange, is a citrus tree believed to be a natural hybrid of Citrus aurantium and Citrus maxima. The health benefits of Citrus × aurantium var. lima include its potential to aid in weight loss, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic agent, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Citrus × aurantium var. lima include limonoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
